_comment: Copy this file to config.local.json and fill in your server details. config.local.json is git-ignored so your API key never gets committed. Every field can also be supplied via environment variables (UNRAID_HOST, UNRAID_PORT, UNRAID_HTTPS, UNRAID_API_KEY, UNRAID_VERIFY_SSL, UNRAID_TIMEOUT), which override the file. Generate the API key in the Unraid webGUI: Settings -> Management Access -> API Keys (grant it the ADMIN role for full control), or via SSH/Terminal: `unraid-api apikey add --name claude-mcp --roles admin`. The ssh_* fields are SEPARATE and OPTIONAL — they only power unraid_ssh_test/unraid_docker_env_get/unraid_docker_env_set (editing a container's env vars, which the GraphQL API cannot do at all). Their env-var overrides are UNRAID_SSH_HOST, UNRAID_SSH_PORT, UNRAID_SSH_USER, UNRAID_SSH_PASSWORD, UNRAID_SSH_KEY_PATH; ssh_host defaults to host. Leave them unset to disable that layer entirely. Use ssh_key_path instead of ssh_password when possible.
